message:
sm_120: four bitwise decode switches on by default on a 12.0 card

Measured on an RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell 72 GB (IQ3_S, every expert in VRAM),
fixed 4-token verify rounds, story / code, the same text as before:
  STRATA_SIDE_MIXER=2   13.67 -> 13.15 ms a round
  STRATA_ATTN_DAILY=1   -> 13.31
  STRATA_GR_DOWN_TG=2   -> 13.34
  STRATA_GR_UP75=1      -> 13.44
  all four              13.70 -> 12.23 ms (2-token rounds 10.37 -> 9.59)
Each is bitwise equal to the kernels it replaces (their parity tests; the
identity gate).  include/strata/core/sm120_series.hpp holds the rule: on for
compute capability 12.0 unless STRATA_SM120_PERF=0; each switch's own
variable still wins in both directions on any card.  The down projection's
token pairs run at every even launch there (Turing keeps 4 and 6 only).
STRATA_ATTN_DAILY / STRATA_ATTN_MERGE_V2 and STRATA_SIDE_MIXER are now
decided per device (a layer split can mix cards).  Other cards: unchanged.

mmvq_il: 5-8 column interleaved kernels and the sm_120 tables (bitwise)

A verify window of 5+ rows fell from the interleaved small-batch kernels (1-4
columns) back to native_mmvq_multi: on an RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell the dense
projections of a round jumped +2.0 ms from T=4 to T=5 (the main Q5_K head
521 -> 1011 us).  native_mmvq_il_kernel now also runs 5-8 columns from the
cp = 8 interleaved copy (1-2 rows a warp), every value bitwise native_mmvq's
(mmvq_il_parity, T 1-8, every rows choice).

Tables for compute capability 12.0, read off mmvq_il_parity --bench
--emit-table on the RTX PRO 5000 (3% rule): kIlRows_120 for 2-4 columns (it
takes the interleaved kernels in more cells than the shared table, e.g. the
head at 2 columns 507 -> 367 us) and kIlRows58_120 for 5-8 columns (the head
at 5 / 8 columns 899 -> 491 / 1178 -> 667 us).  Other cards keep their
tables and native_mmvq at 5+ columns.

STRATA_MMVQ_IL_WIDE=0 turns the 5-8 column path off; STRATA_MMVQ_IL_120=0
gives a 12.0 card the shared 2-4 column table again.

Merge f-146-int (b7505b72a, 0.1.46 engine: Volta perf PRs + QSA_WARP sm<75 fix) into f-split-146

Conflict in src/prefill/prefill.cpp (step 2b): the split rotates mixed into Xr (APR, had_gu)
before 0.1.45's quantize_scatter (NVFP4 activations keep the gather); 0.1.46 adds the pf_wmma
FP16 gather branch. Both kept: wmma_l gathers FP16 rows (and rotates Xs / the swiglu output Hh
in fp16 when the layer is Hadamard-folded), otherwise the split's rotate then quantize_scatter
or the NVFP4 gather.

Merge f-145-pp-volta into f-146-volta (0.1.46): the community Volta/Pascal perf-PR group (35 commits)

Merge resolution as in f-145-perfprs-withvolta: iq_kernels.cu (IQ3_XXS / IQ3_S staged sign-mask tables over the EXPDEC grid staging), prefill/kernels.cu and prefill/prefill.cpp keep both sides; CMakeLists keeps both test blocks.
